title: Corporate Wellness Partnership: enrollment verification and proof-of-employment basis by tier
content:
This document covers the Corporate Wellness Partnership's basis for verifying an employee's employment before their sponsored enrollment is activated: whether verification is required, the grace period allowed to submit proof, whether documented proof is required, and which proof types are accepted.

| Tier | Employment verification required before activation | Grace period to submit proof of employment | Documented proof of employment required | Accepted proof types |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Startup Partner | Yes | 14 calendar days | Yes | Pay stub, employee identification card |
| Small Business Partner | Yes | 14 calendar days | Yes | Pay stub, employee identification card, employer HR letter |
| Mid-Market Partner | Yes | 21 calendar days | Yes | Pay stub, employee identification card, employer HR letter |
| Enterprise Partner | Yes | 30 calendar days | Yes | Pay stub, employee identification card, employer HR letter |
| Municipal Partner | Yes | 30 calendar days | Yes | Employee identification card, employer HR letter |
| Nonprofit Partner | Yes | 30 calendar days | Yes | Employee identification card, employer HR letter |

Every tier requires employment verification before activation and accepts only the proof types listed for that tier; the grace period is the number of calendar days after the application within which that proof must be provided before activation lapses under the enrollment's activation basis.
